versions.changelog:
Initial release of market-recon skill.

- Provides evidence-linked GitHub market reconnaissance reports on AI money trends, hot niches, competitor signals, or "找风口/赚钱方向调研".
- Only fetches data from GitHub (`github.com`/`api.github.com`); no external web search or file writes.
- Includes robust error and rate-limit handling, with explicit disclosure of interruptions and missing data.
- Reports contain direct links, repo stats (stars/velocity), monetization angles, and trend conclusions, all traceable to fetched evidence.
- Designed to support both inline and subagent-assisted reconnaissance for broader coverage.
